column2: For someone like $$セラフィム$$ to suffer such a fate...!
This is terrible!! The sewer entrance has been destroyed!
Was this place not supposed to be safe?!
Where is the enemy?! Stop panicking and tell us!
I do not understand what is happening! Someone tell me what to do!
Damn it! Even the lights have gone out.
This is bad. Everyone is panicking; we cannot get things under control!
